SELECT cs.w_state AS w_state,
       i.i_item_id AS i_item_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cs.d_date < CAST('2001-05-02' AS DATE)
                THEN cs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)
                ELSE 0
           END) AS sales_before,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cs.d_date >= CAST('2001-05-02' AS DATE)
                THEN cs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)
                ELSE 0
           END) AS sales_after
FROM item i
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT w.w_state AS w_state,
           d.d_date AS d_date,
           cs.cs_sales_price AS cs_sales_price,
           cs.cs_order_number AS cs_order_number,
           cs.cs_item_sk AS cs_item_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
      AND d.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-04-02' AS DATE) AND CAST('2001-06-01' AS DATE)
) cs ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT cr.cr_refunded_cash AS cr_refunded_cash
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    WHERE cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
      AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    LIMIT 1
) cr ON true
WHERE i.i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
GROUP BY cs.w_state, i.i_item_id
ORDER BY cs.w_state, i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
